## Fixed: TikTok downloads that got stuck

- **Downloads no longer hang on servers that allow few connections.** Some video sites (TikTok's among them) leave NDM's extra connections unanswered instead of refusing them. Each such connection used to wait out its timeout and try again, over and over, so the download seemed stuck. Now a connection that gets no answer while the others receive gives up within seconds, and NDM keeps to the connections that work.
- **TikTok and Douyin: the right video file.** NDM now takes the one file that has both picture and sound (H.264 first, which every player plays) instead of a video-only stream, some of which are broken, joined with the separate "music" track, which isn't always the video's own sound.
- **Other sites without ffmpeg:** when a site has one file with both picture and sound, NDM takes it instead of separate streams that only ffmpeg can join, so you get one video file instead of a video and a separate sound file.
